source_clause: HVACP11.) HVAC pop ups will only be displayed based on direct user interaction (not automatic system changes to Climate). For example, during ignition cycles there should not be any HVAC pop ups displayed like FAN SPEED or any other HVAC pop ups even if the system has made changes.
reasoning: 驗證目標：14.11（HVACP11）定出 popup 僅由使用者之直接互動觸發，兩個 leaf 分別對應「系統自動變更不顯示」與「直接互動才顯示」。關鍵情境條件：同 14.1.1。為什麼這樣切：兩者為同一規則之正反兩側，依 §7 各自成條 —— 只驗其一即無法區分「永遠不顯示」與「正確地只在互動時顯示」。刻意略過：條文以 ignition cycle 為例，本條照用該例而不擴及其他自動變更 —— 其他情形條文未列舉（§8.4.2）。

interface_axis_review.observable_interface: HVAC popup 本身（其顯示、內容與逾時）
interface_axis_review.axis_9: **不補** —— 6.3 之移除對象為 head unit 之 comfort section，而其明文例外正是 `except for comfort popups`；本節之可觀察量即 popup，故下螢幕車上仍在（**本批首次以證據放下該排除**）
interface_axis_review.axis_12: 不暴露 —— 不觀察 tab
interface_axis_review.axis_13: 暴露 → 全數補（3 旋鈕 ICS 車無 HVAC popup，出處 2.14）
interface_axis_review.emea_ics: 補排除；**逐條答見各 TC 之 `emea_ics_review`** —— `ch16_mirror_map.tsv` 之 **ch14 側全無列**（ch16 十八節無 popup 專章），故全批皆為 `no-counterpart` 而 verdict `yes`

tcs.tc_title: No pop-up appears for automatic system changes
tcs.test_item: HVAC pop ups shall not be displayed for automatic system changes to Climate
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [test-setup] The head unit is on and the climate system is on
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified separately in chapter 16 (16.2)
4. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Start an ignition cycle in which the system changes the fan speed by itself
2. Read the screen for an HVAC pop-up
tcs.expected_result:
1. The ignition cycle completes
2. No HVAC pop-up is shown
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

emea_ics_review.ch16_sentence: ch16 十八節無任何 HVAC popup 之專章（`ch16_mirror_map.tsv` 之 ch14 側全無列）—— 逐條之答為「ch16 無對應句」，故 EMEA ICS 車輛上本條無對象，排除成立

tcs.tc_title: Pop-ups appear only on direct user interaction
tcs.test_item: HVAC pop ups shall only be displayed based on direct user interaction
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [test-setup] The head unit is on and the climate system is on
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified separately in chapter 16 (16.2)
4. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Change the fan speed using the fan speed hard control from a screen other than the climate screen
2. Read the screen for an HVAC pop-up
tcs.expected_result:
1. The fan speed changes
2. A fan pop-up is shown
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
